historicalStatistics.title: The eras in your passport
historicalStatistics.description: See the transformations, former names and vanished attractions that your visits genuinely crossed.

loading.title: Rebuilding your history
loading.description: We are matching your visits with published historical evidence.

errors.title: We could not rebuild your history
errors.load: Historical statistics are unavailable right now.
errors.authentication: Sign in again to view this private page.

empty.title: Your history starts here
empty.description: Add a visit to begin connecting your passport with the way parks have evolved.

evidence.title: Built only from published evidence
evidence.description: A pending report or uncertain record never becomes a statistic. Coverage shows how many of your rides the canonical history can genuinely explain.

eras.title: The eras you experienced
eras.description: A new state is counted when the confirmed open inventory, its names or its categories change between your visits.
eras.empty: There is not enough evidence yet to distinguish several eras.

categories.title: Your categories through time
categories.description: Categories reflect the date of each ride, not today's catalogue.

disappeared.title: You were there before they disappeared
disappeared.description: These attractions were confirmed open when you rode them and are confirmed closed today.
disappeared.empty: No vanished attraction has been established in your passport yet.

transformations.title: The transformations you experienced
transformations.description: The confirmed name or category at your visit differs from today's identity.
transformations.empty: No confirmed transformation connects your visits with the present yet.

names.title: Names at the time of your visits
names.description: Each name is restored in the exact context in which you rode.

historicalStatistics.privacy: These statistics remain private. They are never included in a share unless a sharing policy explicitly allows it.
